cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import zipfile,re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('output/offer_letter_filled.docx')
def txt(part):
    d=z.read(part).decode('utf-8')
    paras=re.findall(r'<w:p[ >].*?</w:p>',d,re.S)
    for i,p in enumerate(paras):
        t=''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>',p,re.S))
        if t.strip(): print('  ['+str(i)+']',repr(t))
print('=== document.xml ===')
txt('word/document.xml')
print('=== header1 ===')
txt('word/header1.xml')
print('=== footer1 ===')
txt('word/footer1.xml')
# leftover placeholder scan across all parts
print('=== leftover {{ scan ===')
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.xml'):
        d=z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
        if '{{' in d or re.search(r'RELOCATION_AMOUNT|IF_RELOCATION',re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',d)):
            print('LEFTOVER in',n)
print('done')
"

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import zipfile,re
from xml.dom.minidom import parseString
z=zipfile.ZipFile('output/offer_letter_filled.docx')
bad=z.testzip()
print('zip integrity:', 'OK' if bad is None else 'BAD '+str(bad))
# parse every xml
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.xml'):
        try: parseString(z.read(n))
        except Exception as e: print('XML PARSE FAIL',n,e)
print('all xml parsed OK')
# all headers/footers
for i in range(1,7):
    for kind in ('header','footer'):
        d=z.read(f'word/{kind}{i}.xml').decode('utf-8')
        plain=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',d)
        assert 'ALDER-4203' in plain and '{{' not in d, f'{kind}{i} fail'
print('all 6 headers + 6 footers filled with RECORD_CODE, no placeholders left')
# compare part count vs source
src=zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
print('parts src vs out:', len(src.namelist()), len(z.namelist()))
"
